teaser: Legal services that scale: agent teams do the reading, lawyers sign, a meter instead of a retainer, and three vaults with real signatures.
core_idea: Legal work runs through every part of a startup and founders rarely have the experience or the lawyers. Models now do the reading and find inconsistencies, so agent teams can drive lawyers' efficiency and the service can scale: on the founder's side, the investor's side and in a deal room where both teams meet, with principles, clauses, versions and understandings signed and verifiable, paid per task or monthly. Founders can publish their terms and let investors debate them. Three made-up vaults show it, built on an open-source stack that exists today.
